text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan presides over Eid al Fitr ceremony.
- King pardons or reduces sentences on more than 500 prisoners.
- Morocco calls for respect of Zaire's territorial unity.
- Moroccan national dies poisoned in Moscow.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri urges local authorities to update electorate lists in due time.
- Morocco's relations with the United States will be boosted more during President Bill Clinton's second term, says U.S. ambassador to Rabat.
- Foreign investors say Morocco following "good track" for reforms but regret not to be able to have more access, through the country, to the wider market of the Maghreb.
